name: The Great Outdoors

angles.text: A traditional Orcish “Lok-tar” greets new Horde adventurers as they learn the basics of survival before setting out across treacherous territories.

faq.answer: Brakk’s lesson teaches new adventurers to rest beside a campfire before taking up a profession.
Brakk welcomes restless travelers seeking fortune and glory and teaches practical ways to survive in the wild and rest by a campfire.
Resting near Brakk’s Basic Campfire grants the Boosted Rest buff and shows how an open flame can help an adventurer recover in the wild.
faq.q: What is the Boosted Rest buff?

faq.answer: After learning how to rest in the wild, visit trainers in the nearby village to study a tradeskill and learn to build camp fixtures suited to that craft.
faq.q: What should you do after completing the quest?

faq.answer: Camp fixtures are campsite installations taught by profession trainers in nearby villages. They let travelers adapt their camps to support their chosen tradeskills.
This lesson is for restless souls seeking fortune and glory in the wild, especially those just beginning their journey and preparing to choose a trade.
faq.q: Who is this training intended for?

sections.body: Brakk greets aspiring adventurers with a hearty “Lok-tar” and welcomes those seeking fortune and glory. The road through Azeroth’s wilds asks for more than skill at arms; travelers must also endure the elements. Learning to make camp and regain strength is a first step toward surviving out there.
sections.title: Lessons in the Wild

sections.body: Rest beside Brakk’s Basic Campfire brings a restorative pause in the open air and teaches travelers how to recover. Once they know these basics, novice adventurers can visit craftsmen in a nearby village. There, they can study tradeskills and learn to build camp fixtures suited to their chosen craft.
sections.title: From Hearth to Craft

summary: Brakk welcomes travelers beside his Basic Campfire and teaches them to rest in the wild. From there, they turn to practical crafts.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Outdoors
